finalText:
**CHANGELOG.md now has a 4.2.0 section.** No breaking changes this time.

One new feature: webhook deliveries that fail now retry themselves with backoff.

Ten real fixes made the cut, out of 380 commits. The big ones: expired tokens now correctly return 401, the database stopped logging full request bodies, and four different list endpoints (queue, API, webhooks, database) no longer choke on a null pagination cursor. Smaller ones cover a duplicate header, a double-trimmed trailing slash, an unhandled empty allowlist, trace ids dropping on retry, an HTTP pool leak on shutdown, a stray timer, wrong metric units, and fuzzy token-parse errors.

Everything else — the dependency bumps, renames, and file-splitting — didn't touch behavior, so it's left out.
